#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Get the real physical path of the script (handle soft links)
SOURCE="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
while [ -h "$SOURCE" ]; do
  DIR="$( cd -P "$( dirname "$SOURCE" )" && pwd )"
  SOURCE="$(readlink "$SOURCE")"
  [[ $SOURCE != /* ]] && SOURCE="$DIR/$SOURCE"
done
SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -P "$( dirname "$SOURCE" )" && pwd )"

# Locate the SDK root directory (since the script is in contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/tools/, the root is three levels up)
SDK_ROOT=$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../" && pwd)
NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT="$SCRIPT_DIR/nuttx_build.sh"

if [  ! -d "$SCRIPT_DIR/../toolchain" ]; then
    echo "Info: Toolchain directory not found. Setting up toolchain..."
    chmod +x $SCRIPT_DIR/env.sh
    $SCRIPT_DIR/env.sh 
fi
# Install commit-msg hook automatically (solution 3 implementation)
# Ensure that Change-Id can be used in the contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang project for code review
HOOKS_DIR="$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/.git/hooks"
REPO_HOOK="$SDK_ROOT/.repo/repo/hooks/commit-msg"

if [ -d "$HOOKS_DIR" ] && [ -f "$REPO_HOOK" ] && [ ! -f "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg" ]; then
    echo "Info: Installing commit-msg hook for contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang..."
    cp "$REPO_HOOK" "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
    chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
fi


# Show help message
function show_help() {
    echo "Usage: ./artbuild.sh [BOARD] [PROJECT] [OPTION]"
    echo ""
    echo "BOARD:"
    echo "  d13x_demo88-nor    Build for signal board"
    echo "PROJECT:"
    echo "  nsh         Build the project for NSH"
    echo "  nsh_cxx     Build the project for NSH with C++ 14.1 support"
    echo "  xts_opus    Build the project for XTS OPUS"
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  (none)      Build the project and pack the image (default)"
    echo "  rebuild     Clean (distclean), build the project, and pack the image"
    echo "  pack        Only pack the image"
    echo "  help        Show this help message"
    echo "  [custom]    Pass custom options directly to build.sh (e.g., clean, menuconfig)"
    echo ""
    echo "Example:"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl           # Build and pack for d13x chip (default)"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl build     # Build "
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl rebuild   # Full clean, build, and pack for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl distclean # Only run distclean via build.sh for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl clean     # Only run clean via build.sh for d13x chip"
}


if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ "$1" == "help" ] || [ "$1" == "-h" ] || [ "$1" == "--help" ]; then
    show_help
    exit 1
fi

board=$1
pro=$2
if [ $# -ge 3 ]; then
opt=${@:3}
fi

# Define board configuration path for the project
BOARD_CONFIG_DIR="contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$board/configs/$pro"
CHIP_NAME=$(echo $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR | cut -d'/' -f3)
IMAGE_NAME="${CHIP_NAME}_v1.0.0.img"

echo "Building for board: $board, project: $pro, option: $opt"
echo  "BOARD_CONFIG_DIR: $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR, CHIP_NAME: $CHIP_NAME, IMAGE_NAME: $IMAGE_NAME"

# Check if help requests are made
if [ "$opt" == "help" ] || [ "$opt" == "-h" ] || [ "$opt" == "--help" ]; then
    show_help
    exit 0
fi
# If no option is provided, default to build + pack
if [ -z "$opt" ]; then
   echo "No option provided. Defaulting to: build + pack"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR -j8
   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
       echo "Build failed. Exiting."
       exit 1
   fi
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   exit 0
fi

# Add build option: execute build only
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "build"; then
   echo "No option provided. Defaulting to: build only"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR $opt
   exit 0
fi

# Add clean option: execute distclean with path recovery
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "distclean"; then
   echo "Cleaning: distclean with path recovery"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR distclean 
   # 1. Remove all conflicting files
   rm -rf nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
   rm -rf nuttx/include/arch
   rm -f nuttx/Make.defs
   rm -rf contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/prebuilt/*

fi

# Add rebuild option: execute distclean + build + pack
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "rebuild"; then
   echo "Rebuilding: distclean + build + pack"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   
   # 1. Remove all conflicting files
   rm -rf nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
   rm -rf nuttx/include/arch
   rm -f nuttx/Make.defs

   # 2. Parse defconfig to get chip absolute path (adapt SDK_ROOT)
   DEFCONFIG="$SDK_ROOT/$BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/defconfig"
   if [ -f "$DEFCONFIG" ]; then
       CHIP_VAL=$(grep "^CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR=" "$DEFCONFIG" | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d '"')
       CHIP_REL=${CHIP_VAL#../} 
       CHIP_ABS="$SDK_ROOT/$CHIP_REL"

       if [ -d "$CHIP_ABS" ]; then
           echo "Runing pre-link for chip: $CHIP_ABS"
           mkdir -p nuttx/arch/risc-v/src
           ln -sf "$CHIP_ABS" nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
       else
           echo "Warning: Chip dir from defconfig not found: $CHIP_ABS"
       fi
   fi

   # 3. Parse board configuration to get Make.defs path (adapt SDK_ROOT)
   MAKEDEFS_SRC="$SDK_ROOT/$BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/../../scripts/Make.defs"

   if [ -f "$MAKEDEFS_SRC" ]; then
       ln -sf "$MAKEDEFS_SRC" "$SDK_ROOT/nuttx/Make.defs"
   fi

   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/ distclean -j8
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/ -j8
   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
       echo "Build failed. Exiting."
       exit 1
   fi
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   echo "cp image completed $SDK_ROOT/$IMAGE_NAME"
   exit 0
fi

echo "Building with option: $opt"

if [ "$opt"x != "packx" ]; then
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR $opt
else
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   echo "cp image completed $SDK_ROOT/$IMAGE_NAME "
fi

#			$(VAR_1) = a b c

	$(eval BATCH_SIZE = $(3))

      "qemu-utils" \
  )

  local boardconfig=$1
  if [ -f ${ROOTDIR}/${boardconfig}/defconfig ]; then
    dconfig=${ROOTDIR}/${boardconfig}/defconfig
  else
    configdir=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -s -d':' -f2`
    if [ -z "${configdir}" ]; then
      boarddir=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d'/' -f1`
      configdir=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d'/' -f2`
    else
      boarddir=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d':' -f1`
    fi
    configpath=${NUTTXDIR}/boards/*/*/${boarddir}/configs/${configdir}
    dconfig=${configpath}/defconfig
  fi

  if [ ! -r ${dconfig} ]; then
    echo "File ${dconfig} does not exist"
    exit 5
  fi

  if grep -q "CONFIG_ARCH_SIM" $dconfig >/dev/null; then
      if grep -q "CONFIG_SIM_M32" $dconfig >/dev/null; then
          PACKAGES+=("${SIM_X86_PACKAGES[@]}")
      else
          PACKAGES+=("${SIM_X86_64_PACKAGES[@]}")
      fi
  fi
  if grep -q "CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_QEMU" $dconfig >/dev/null; then
      PACKAGES+=("${QEMU_PACKAGES[@]}")
  fi

  for (( i = 0; i < ${#PACKAGES[*]}; i++)); do
    dpkg -l ${PACKAGES[$i]} > /dev/null 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "WARNING: no packages found matching ${PACKAGES[$i]}"
      INSTALLS[${#INSTALLS[@]}]=${PACKAGES[$i]}
    fi
  done

  if [ ${#INSTALLS[*]} -eq 0 ]; then
    return
  fi

  if [ ${#INSTALLS[*]} -eq 1 ] && [ "${INSTALLS[0]}" == "kconfig-frontends" ]; then
    return
  fi

  echo "*************************************************************************************"
  echo "The environment of Vela depends on above tools, Run the following command to install:"
  echo ""

  for (( i = 0; i < ${#INSTALLS[*]}; i++)); do
    if [[ "${INSTALLS[$i]}" == *":i386" ]]; then
      echo " sudo dpkg --add-architecture i386"
      break
    fi
  done

  for (( i = 0; i < ${#INSTALLS[*]}; i++)); do
    result=`apt-cache search ${INSTALLS[$i]}`
    if [ "$result" == "" ]; then
      if [ "${INSTALLS[$i]}" == "kconfig-frontends" ]; then
        unset INSTALLS[$i]
      fi
    fi
  done

  echo " sudo apt-get update"
  echo " sudo apt-get install -y ${INSTALLS[@]}"
  echo ""
  echo "*************************************************************************************"
}

排查结果：之前显示的是 `app_lvgldemo`，不是你的 `lvgl_app`。

原因有两个：

1. `lvgl_app` 只有 Kconfig 打开了，但没有被总构建入口拉进 `CONFIGURED_APPS`，所以不会注册成 builtin app。
2. `app_lvgldemo` 默认 `AUTOSTART=y`，启动时 constructor 会自动 spawn `app_lvgldemo`，所以屏幕被它占了。

我已经改了：

- [app/Make.defs](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Make.defs:37)：加入 `lvgl_app/Make.defs`，让 `lvgl_app` 真正参与构建。
- [defconfig](/data/work/0713_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/d13x_demo88-nor/configs/nsh_lvgl/defconfig:9)：关闭 `APP_LOCAL_LVGLDEMO` 和 `EXAMPLES_LVGLDEMO`，打开 `CONFIG_LVGL_APP_APP_MAIN_AUTOSTART=y`。

验证已跑完：

```bash
./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl rebuild
```

结果成功生成镜像：

```text
/data/work/0713_vela/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img
```

当前 registry 确认只有：

```text
{"lvgl_app", 100, 32768, lvgl_app_main}
```

没有 `app_lvgldemo`。打包时有一个已有风险提示：`artinchip_os.itb` 大于 `0x400000` 分区大小，但脚本仍返回成功并生成了镜像。
